title: The level themes and what they hold
summary: Levels in R.E.P.O. are themed rather than generic: the game ships artwork per theme, such as arctic, manor, museum and forest, and each theme brings its own props and valuables.
body: Levels come in themes. The game ships separate artwork per theme, with sets named for arctic, manor, museum, forest, harbour, suburb and wasteland, which is why two levels can look nothing alike.
A theme brings its own props. The arctic set alone covers server racks, sample coolers, laptops and ice blocks, so a theme is a whole kit rather than a change of colour.
It brings its own valuables. Arctic valuables are named as arctic items rather than generic ones, which is why what is worth taking changes with where you are.
Special modules are part of the plan. A level description names its own special modules, so themed rooms are placed deliberately rather than turning up at random.
Preferred valuables are recorded per level. A level carries a set of valuables it prefers, which is why two levels of the same theme can still differ.
Not everything is a room. Props such as signs, stairs, railings and cloaks exist per theme as well, so the scenery belongs to the same kit as the loot.
What this entry does not tell you: how many levels each theme has, how often a theme appears, or what anything is worth. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The game ships separate level artwork per theme, including arctic, manor, museum and forest.
facts.evidence: identifiers: level arctic 01, level manor 01, level museum 01, level shop forest 01

facts.claim: Each theme also has ambience of its own, kept as loops per theme and per part of the level.
facts.evidence: asset names: Ambience Loop Arctic Default, Ambience Loop Manor Default, Ambience Loop Manor Outside Crickets

facts.claim: A theme brings its own props and valuables, named for that theme.
facts.evidence: identifiers: Valuable Arctic Laptop_DefaultMaterial_BaseColor, Valuable Arctic Server Rack_DefaultMaterial_BaseColor, Valuable Arctic Sample Cooler_DefaultMaterial_BaseColor

facts.claim: A theme carries scenery of its own, not only loot.
facts.evidence: identifiers: Wizard Cloak, Wizard Stairs Dungeon, Wizard Sign Common Room

facts.claim: A level description names its own special modules.
facts.evidence: identifiers: Level, ModulesSpecial

facts.claim: A level records a set of valuables it prefers.
facts.evidence: identifier: ValuablePresets

facts.claim: The themes are not limited to the four best known: an arena has level artwork of its own alongside the arctic, manor, museum and forest pictures.
facts.evidence: identifiers: level arena 01, level arctic 01

facts.claim: A theme brings its own fittings as well: the manor ships a sauna with an oven and a shower, and a fridge with a base and doors.
facts.evidence: asset names: Sauna Oven, Shower Albedo, Fridge_base, Fridge_door01

facts.claim: The arctic theme carries ambience of its own, including a water facility and distant machinery.
facts.evidence: asset names: Ambience Loop Arctic Water Facility, Ambience Loop Arctic Distant Mechanical, Ambience Loop Arctic Generic Machinery2

facts.claim: Themes bring their own furniture as well: the manor ships a grandfather clock with its own glass.
facts.evidence: asset names: Grandfather Clock, Clock Glass, Clock_Material_BaseColor

facts.claim: Manor ambience has outside variants of its own, including one by a window, one of creaky metal and one of crickets.
facts.evidence: asset names: Ambience Loop Manor Outside By Window, Ambience Loop Manor Outside Creaky Metal, Ambience Loop Manor Outside Crickets

facts.claim: The arctic theme ships building pieces of its own, including door signs and window frames.
facts.evidence: asset names: Arctic Door Sign, Arctic Window Frame

facts.claim: It also ships an outdoor unit of its own, a portable toilet with a door and a locked state.
facts.evidence: asset names: Arctic Bajamaja, Arctic Bajamaja Door, Arctic Bajamaja Locked

facts.claim: The manor theme fits out a bathroom of its own, with a floor and rugs among its pieces.
facts.evidence: asset names: Bathroom, Bathroom Floor, Bathroom Rug

facts.claim: The arctic theme names signs of its own, for a bathroom, a research lab and an exotic materials division.
facts.evidence: asset names: Arctic Sign Bathroom, Arctic Sign Research Lab, Arctic Sign Exotic Materials Division

facts.claim: The arctic set has its own valuables, named one by one: a camera, a centrifuge, a cup, an eraser, a phone, a smart watch, a stapler, a USB stick and a VHS among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Arctic Valuable Camera, Arctic Valuable Centrifuge, Arctic Valuable Cup, Arctic Valuable Eraser, Arctic Valuable Phone, Arctic Valuable Smart Watch, Arctic Valuable Stapler, Arctic Valuable Usb stick, Arctic Valuable VHS

facts.claim: The wizard set names valuables of its own, a goblin arm, a sword, a small green potion, a tiny pack and a bug for the arachnophobes, while the museum set names a horse and a milk among its own.
facts.evidence: asset names: Wizard Valuable Goblin Arm, Wizard Valuable Sword, Wizard valuable small potion green, Wizard valuable tiny pack, Wizard Valuable Bug (Arachnophobia), Museum Valuable Horse, Museum valuable milk

facts.claim: The wizard theme names a sign for each of its rooms, more than twenty of them, from a common room and a dormatory to the great library and the sludge pits.
facts.evidence: asset names: Wizard Sign Common Room, Wizard Sign Dormatory, Wizard Sign The Great Library, Wizard Sign Sludge Pits, Wizard Sign East Wing Lobby

facts.claim: The arctic theme ships a sign of its own as a sheet, a specimen-research sign with an atom on it.
facts.evidence: asset name: Arctic Sign Specimen

facts.claim: The wizard theme hangs a welcome banner of its own, with a back for it and a blue wall flag.
facts.evidence: asset names: Wizard Welcome Banner, Wizard Welcome Banner Back, Wizard Wall Flag_blue

facts.claim: A garden is fitted with pieces of its own: garden props, a rock bench, tombstones, a roof and a wall planter, with a greenhouse that carries an opaque material and a transparent one.
facts.evidence: asset names: Garden Props, Garden Rock Bench, Garden Tombstones, Garden Roof, Garden Wall Planter, Greenhouse material OPAQUE, Greenhouse material TRANSPARENT

facts.claim: The wizard theme fits its rooms with pieces of its own: a bookshelf, an arch and a big lecture podium.
facts.evidence: asset names: Wizard Bookshelf, Wizard Arch, Wizard Big Lecture Podium

alt.en: The game's own picture for its arctic level theme: a drawn snow base with a dome, dishes and a satellite mast.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的极地关卡主题图：画着带穹顶、天线盘与卫星杆的雪地基地。

alt.en: The game's own picture for its arena level theme: a barn beside a dark trail of watching eyes.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的竞技场关卡主题图：谷仓旁边是一条布满窥视眼睛的暗色路径。

alt.en: A sign the wizard theme hangs on its walls: a gold plaque on a wooden arch, reading Common Room.
alt.zh: 巫师主题挂在墙上的标牌：木弧形托着的金色铭牌，写着 Common Room。

alt.en: A second wizard sign, reading Dormatory.
alt.zh: 第二块巫师主题标牌，写着 Dormatory。

alt.en: A third wizard sign, reading The Great Library.
alt.zh: 第三块巫师主题标牌，写着 The Great Library。

alt.en: A fourth wizard sign, reading Sludge Pits of Truth.
alt.zh: 第四块巫师主题标牌，写着 Sludge Pits of Truth。

alt.en: A sign the arctic theme hangs on its walls: a white plaque reading Specimen Research beside an orange atom.
alt.zh: 极地主题挂在墙上的标牌：白色牌面写着 Specimen Research，旁边是橙色原子图案。

alt.en: A banner the wizard theme hangs: a blue ribbon lettered Welcome New Students between two dark marks.
alt.zh: 巫师主题挂出的横幅：蓝色缎带上写着 Welcome New Students，两端各有一个深色符号。

alt.en: A piece of the manor theme's bathroom: its round purple rug. A rug is a flat mat, so the sheet is plain by design.
alt.zh: 庄园主题浴室的一件陈设：圆形紫色地毯。地毯本就是平面织物，贴图素净是应然。

alt.en: Diagram: a theme is chosen, its props and valuables are placed, and the crew works out what is worth taking.
alt.zh: 示意图：选定主题、放置其道具与贵重物品、小队判断哪些值得带走。

sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Identifiers are listed on the technical reference pages; nothing here is estimated.
